1: asanśhayaṁ samagraṁ māṁ yathā jñāsyasi tach chhṛiṇu ||
3: yatatām api siddhānāṁ kaśhchin māṁ vetti tattvataḥ ||
4: bhūmir-āpo ’nalo vāyuḥ khaṁ mano buddhir eva cha |
ahankāra itīyaṁ me bhinnā prakṛitir aṣhṭadhā ||
5: apareyam itas tvanyāṁ prakṛitiṁ viddhi me parām |
6: ahaṁ kṛitsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayas tathā ||
7: mattaḥ parataraṁ nānyat kiñchid asti dhanañjaya |
mayi sarvam idaṁ protaṁ sūtre maṇi-gaṇā iva ||
8: praṇavaḥ sarva-vedeṣhu śhabdaḥ khe pauruṣhaṁ nṛiṣhu ||
9: puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛithivyāṁ cha tejaśh chāsmi vibhāvasau |
10: bījaṁ māṁ sarva-bhūtānāṁ viddhi pārtha sanātanam |
buddhir buddhimatām asmi tejas tejasvinām aham ||
12: ye chaiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasās tāmasāśh cha ye |
matta eveti tān viddhi na tvahaṁ teṣhu te mayi ||
13: tribhir guṇa-mayair bhāvair ebhiḥ sarvam idaṁ jagat |
14: daivī hyeṣhā guṇa-mayī mama māyā duratyayā |
mām eva ye prapadyante māyām etāṁ taranti te ||
15: na māṁ duṣhkṛitino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ |
16: ārto jijñāsur arthārthī jñānī cha bharatarṣhabha ||
17: priyo hi jñānino ’tyartham ahaṁ sa cha mama priyaḥ ||
18: udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam |
āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā mām evānuttamāṁ gatim ||
19: bahūnāṁ janmanām ante jñānavān māṁ prapadyate |
vāsudevaḥ sarvam iti sa mahātmā su-durlabhaḥ ||
20: taṁ taṁ niyamam āsthāya prakṛityā niyatāḥ svayā ||
21: yo yo yāṁ yāṁ tanuṁ bhaktaḥ śhraddhayārchitum ichchhati |
tasya tasyāchalāṁ śhraddhāṁ tām eva vidadhāmyaham ||
22: sa tayā śhraddhayā yuktas tasyārādhanam īhate |
labhate cha tataḥ kāmān mayaiva vihitān hi tān ||
23: antavat tu phalaṁ teṣhāṁ tad bhavatyalpa-medhasām |
devān deva-yajo yānti mad-bhaktā yānti mām api ||
24: avyaktaṁ vyaktim āpannaṁ manyante mām abuddhayaḥ |
25: mūḍho ’yaṁ nābhijānāti loko mām ajam avyayam ||
26: bhaviṣhyāṇi cha bhūtāni māṁ tu veda na kaśhchana ||
29: te brahma tadviduḥ kṛitsnam adhyātmaṁ karma chākhilam ||
30: sādhibhūtādhidaivaṁ māṁ sādhiyajñaṁ cha ye viduḥ |
prayāṇa-kāle ’pi cha māṁ te vidur yukta-chetasaḥ ||
